handle.name: handle
handle.description: A public name that belongs to one person until they release it, and is the address of a public page.

link.name: link
link.description: A title and web address on a public page.

profile.name: profile
profile.description: A claimed name's public page, with its links in the order they were put.

handle.claim.name: handle.claim
handle.claim.description: Claim a free name and make it the address of your public page, with its profile.

handle.release.name: handle.release
handle.release.description: Free your name and take its public page offline. Anyone may claim the name afterwards.

handle.resolve.name: handle.resolve
handle.resolve.description: Find the handle that holds a claimed name. A released or unclaimed name has none.

link.add.name: link.add
link.add.description: Append a link to your own public page. You need a claimed name first.

link.order.name: link.order
link.order.description: Move a link to a zero-based position. A position past the end puts it last.

link.remove.name: link.remove
link.remove.description: Remove a link from a public page.

profile.get.name: profile.get
profile.get.description: Read a claimed name's public page and its links in display order.
